title: grafana-plugin-compat: Grafana packages must be peerDependencies with a semver range, not pinned/workspace deps
answers: Should @grafana/data be a dependency or peerDependency in grafana-plugin-compat?
Why does grafana-plugin-compat/package.json use '>=12.0.0' instead of 'workspace:*' for grafana packages?
How do I add a new @grafana/* import to the plugin-compat package?
body:
Symptom (would appear later): adding `import ... from '@grafana/schema'` or similar to grafana-plugin-compat source without updating package.json breaks consumers pinning this package to a version independent of their Grafana host version.
Root cause/convention: packages/grafana-plugin-compat/package.json lists @grafana/data, @grafana/runtime, @grafana/schema as `peerDependencies` with ranges like `>=12.0.0`, never as `dependencies`/`devDependencies` pinned to `workspace:*` - this package is published and versioned separately from Grafana core so it must not hard-pin a workspace version.
Fix pattern: any new import from a @grafana/* package in this package's src must be added/kept as a peerDependency with a minimum-version range, and removed from devDependencies if present there.
Constraints: applies specifically to packages/grafana-plugin-compat (and any other independently-versioned plugin-compat-style package); does not apply to normal in-repo Grafana packages that use workspace:* freely.
